speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I see you are presenting with a breast mass; to begin our evaluation, have you noticed any changes in the size, shape, or texture of this mass recently? Additionally, have you experienced any pain, skin changes like dimpling, or discharge from the nipple?

speaker: Patient
text: 48-year-old woman. The patient noticed a mass in her left breast 4 weeks ago, which has rapidly increased in size. She denies any recent trauma or infections. No history of similar complaints in the past.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Rapidly growing breast mass in a 48-year-old woman is highly suspicious for a high-grade malignancy, such as inflammatory breast cancer or a high-grade invasive carcinoma. We must proceed immediately with a breast MRI and core needle biopsy to confirm the diagnosis.
